summary: Operator page (kewadin.com, dated 2026-07-08): Kewadin Sault RV Park is a dedicated 64-site park with 20 pull-throughs and 30-amp service, sold at $30 a night (was ~$25 in the note) or $810 per 30 days; dump station, potable water station, hotel showers. Added fees $30, confirmed 30-amp, 64 sites, pull-through, showers/dump/potable water; cleared the derived site-water hookup (only a potable water station is listed, unlike St. Ignace's 'Water hook-ups at site'). Phone 1-800-KEWADIN (539-2346) is the only number given for the RV parks, matching the entry. Not stated: season (May-Oct derived, left), max length (70 ft derived, left), laundry (derived, left), how to reserve (phone derived, left). Gate: $30, under US$50 (no gateway within 40 km; family has not stayed). Note cleaned of hookup, site, season, price and booking text.
